
  ▲ vercel env command

  Interact with Environment Variables for a Project                             

  Commands:

  add     name        Add an Environment Variable                         
  list                List all Environment Variables for a Project        
  pull    [filename]  Pull Environment Variables into a local file        
                      (default: .env.local)                               
  remove  name        Remove an Environment Variable (see examples below) 
  run     command     Run a command with environment variables from the   
                      linked Vercel project                               
  update  name        Update the value of an existing Environment Variable
                      (see examples below)                                


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Run a command with Environment Variables from the linked Project

    $ vercel env run -- <command>

  - Add one variable to multiple Environments

    $ vercel env add API_URL production,preview,development
